system_overview: warehouse-bin-audit is a barcode-driven warehouse bin auditing with offline sync. It is built as a small focused system with Scanner PWA at its core, supported by Sync Engine (CRDT) and Discrepancy Reporter.

recommended_language.rationale: Rust fits the barcode-driven warehouse bin auditing with offline sync workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Scanner PWA as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The barcode-driven warehouse bin auditing with offline sync hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Discrepancy Reporter asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Bin, Item, AuditRun must persist relationally
Components: Scanner PWA, Sync Engine (CRDT), Discrepancy Reporter
